opening_hours.notes: Extended hours during summer.

places.place_tip: Book tickets online to avoid queues.

places.name: Bath Abbey
places.ai_summary: A stunning Gothic abbey with beautiful stained glass windows and a rich history dating back to the 7th century.

opening_hours.notes: Closed during services.

places.place_tip: Climb the tower for panoramic views of Bath.

places.name: Royal Crescent
places.ai_summary: A sweeping crescent of Georgian architecture, offering a glimpse into Bath's elegant past and stunning views of the city.

opening_hours.notes: Best viewed from the park opposite.

places.place_tip: Visit the No. 1 Royal Crescent museum to see how Georgians lived.

places.name: The Circus
places.ai_summary: A circular space surrounded by large Georgian townhouses, notable for its unique architecture and historical significance.

opening_hours.notes: Public space, accessible at all times.

places.place_tip: Look out for the intricate stone carvings on the buildings.
places.address: The Circus, Bath BA1 2ET, United Kingdom

places.name: Pulteney Bridge
places.ai_summary: An iconic bridge in Bath, known for its picturesque views and shops built across its full span.

opening_hours.notes: Best viewed from the riverbank.

places.place_tip: Visit the shops on the bridge for unique souvenirs.
places.address: Pulteney Bridge, Bath BA2 4AX, United Kingdom

places.name: Thermae Bath Spa
places.ai_summary: The only natural thermal hot springs in Britain, offering a unique spa experience in a stunning modern setting.

opening_hours.notes: Pre-booking essential, especially for sunset sessions.

places.place_tip: Try to book a treatment for the full spa experience.
places.address: Thermae Bath Spa, Bath BA1 1SJ, United Kingdom

places.name: Holburne Museum
places.ai_summary: An art museum in Bath, featuring a fine collection of paintings, silver, and ceramics, set in a beautiful Georgian building.

opening_hours.notes: Check for special exhibitions and events.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the beautiful gardens surrounding the museum.
places.address: Holburne Museum, Bath BA2 4DB, United Kingdom

places.ai_summary: A scenic walking route offering stunning views of Bath and the surrounding countryside, showcasing the city's natural beauty.

places.ai_summary: A fascinating museum in Bath, exploring the history of communication and the postal service, with interactive exhibits and displays.

opening_hours.notes: Check for special events and exhibitions.

places.name: Beckford’s Tower
places.ai_summary: A historic tower in Bath, offering panoramic views of the city and the surrounding countryside, with a museum dedicated to William Beckford.

opening_hours.notes: Last entry one hour before closing.

places.place_tip: The climb to the top is steep but offers the best views in Bath.
places.address: Beckford’s Tower, Bath BA1 4AA, United Kingdom

attribution.title: Beckford's Tower - geograph.org.uk - 746959
attribution.author: John Sparshatt
attribution.description: Beckford's Tower Beckfords Tower was designed by Henry Edmund Goodridge in 1825 and completed in 1827 for William Beckford (1760-1844), one of the nations most accomplished and interesting characters. The 120-foot neo-classical Tower, which enjoys uninterrupted views of the countryside, was constructed as a study retreat and to house Beckfords precious collection of art and rare books.

places.name: Alexandra Park Viewpoint
places.ai_summary: A popular viewpoint in Bath, providing stunning panoramic views of the city, the Abbey, and the surrounding countryside.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited at sunrise or sunset.

places.place_tip: Bring a camera, the views are breathtaking.
places.address: Alexandra Park, Bath BA1 6AE, United Kingdom

places.name: Guildhall Market
places.ai_summary: A historic market in Bath, offering a variety of local produce, crafts, and goods in a vibrant and bustling atmosphere.

opening_hours.notes: Check for seasonal opening times.

places.place_tip: Try the local delicacies at the food stalls.
places.address: Guildhall Market, Bath BA1 5AW, United Kingdom

places.name: Sally Lunn’s Historic Eating House
places.ai_summary: One of the oldest houses in Bath, now a museum and restaurant, famous for its traditional Bath buns and historic ambiance.

opening_hours.notes: Reservations recommended for lunch and tea.

places.place_tip: Try the original Sally Lunn bun with cream and jam.
places.address: Sally Lunn’s, 4 North Parade, Bath BA1 1NX, United Kingdom

places.name: Herschel Museum of Astronomy
places.ai_summary: A museum dedicated to the history of astronomy, located in the former home of astronomer William Herschel, featuring exhibits and a planetarium.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the interactive exhibits and the beautiful garden.
